title: AgentToClientAction
description: Action message emitted by the SeeGuide deterministic agent policy to the client device

text.description: Spoken auditory text or empty string when silent

priority.description: Action urgency priority: P0 (immediate hazard interrupt), P1 (reframe/guidance), P2 (informational/OCR), P3 (background/silent)

vibrate.description: Whether to trigger device haptic vibration feedback

direction.description: Directional prompt when reframing or localizing an obstacle

request_id.description: Identifier correlating action to source frame or client request

confirm_id.description: Confirmation identifier when asking user approval (e.g. before reading long text)

reason.description: Deterministic policy rationale for auditing, debugging, and tracing
